title: How to Use the Elbow Method in K-Means Clustering: A Step-by-Step Guide

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we're talking about the elbow method.
cues.zh: 今天要談手肘法。

cues.en: So here, we have our data points.
cues.zh: 這裡是我們的資料點。

cues.en: And as you can see, they're in two dimensions.
cues.zh: 如你所見，它們位於二維空間。

cues.en: I just wanted to say, before we continue, that k-means clustering doesn't necessarily have to work in just two dimensions.
cues.zh: 繼續之前，先說明一下：K-means 分群不一定只能處理二維資料。

cues.en: It can work in many dimensions, but for simplicity's sake, we're looking at two-dimensional examples because they're easier to illustrate.
cues.zh: 它也能處理多維資料，但為了簡單起見，我們看二維例子，因為比較容易用圖示說明。

cues.en: So our data points are here, and we already know how k-means clustering works.
cues.zh: 資料點在這裡，而我們已經知道 K-means 分群如何運作。

cues.en: The question is, how do we decide how many clusters to select in that very first step?
cues.zh: 問題是，第一步要怎麼決定選擇幾個群組呢？

cues.en: Because it's up to us.
cues.zh: 因為這是由我們決定的。

cues.en: Well, the elbow method is one of the approaches to help you make this decision.
cues.zh: 手肘法就是協助你做這個決定的方法之一。

cues.en: There are other methods as well, and moreover, sometimes, you might already know in advance from your domain knowledge about the problem how many clusters there should be
cues.zh: 還有其他方法，而且有時候根據你對問題的領域知識，可能事先就知道應該有幾個群組，

cues.en: or how many classes you would like to have.
cues.zh: 或者希望有幾個類別。

cues.en: But if that information's not available, then the elbow method is a pretty good way of finding the optimal number of clusters.
cues.zh: 但如果沒有這些資訊，手肘法就是找出最佳群組數量的好方法。

cues.en: So the elbow method requires us to look at this equation for the Within Cluster Sum of Squares, or the WCSS.
cues.zh: 手肘法需要用到這個公式，也就是群內平方和，簡稱 WCSS。

cues.en: Don't worry if it looks a bit complex at first.
cues.zh: 乍看有點複雜也不用擔心。

cues.en: It's actually very simple.
cues.zh: 它其實很簡單。

cues.en: It basically looks at the distance between each point and the centroid of its cluster, and you square that distance.
cues.zh: 基本上就是看每個點與所屬群組質心之間的距離，再把距離平方。

cues.en: So let's have a look at this in an example.
cues.zh: 我們用例子來看看。

cues.en: If those are our data points and we have one cluster, then we just need to measure the distance between each point and that centroid and square it and add them up.
cues.zh: 假設這些是資料點，而且只有一個群組，就要量出每個點到質心的距離，平方後再全部相加。

cues.en: If we have two clusters, then we need to do that for the red points on their own, calculate the distance between each point and centroid, square them, add them up,
cues.zh: 如果有兩個群組，就先單獨處理紅點：計算每個點到質心的距離，平方後相加，

cues.en: and then do the same for the blue points, and then add them up again.
cues.zh: 接著對藍點做同樣的事，最後再把兩者加起來。

cues.en: And same thing for three clusters.
cues.zh: 三個群組也是一樣。

cues.en: So, two things to point out here.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩件事要指出。

cues.en: First one is, as you can see, to calculate all these different within cluster sum of squares for the different options, we actually need the clusters to already exist.
cues.zh: 第一，如你所見，要計算不同選項的群內平方和，實際上必須先有群組。

cues.en: So every time, we have to first run the k-means clustering algorithm, and then we calculate the WCSS.
cues.zh: 所以每次都要先執行 K-means 分群演算法，再計算 WCSS。

cues.en: So it's kind of a bit backwards.
cues.zh: 順序有點反過來。

cues.en: We don't first do the elbow method to find the optimal number of clusters and then do k-means.
cues.zh: 我們不是先用手肘法找出最佳群組數量，再執行 K-means。

cues.en: We do k-means many times, find the WCSS for every single setup, whether it's one cluster, 2, 3, 4, 5, and so on,
cues.zh: 而是執行很多次 K-means，計算每種設定的 WCSS，包括一群、兩群、三群、四群、五群等等，

cues.en: and then we will be able to apply the elbow method, which is coming up on the next slide.
cues.zh: 然後才能套用手肘法，下一張投影片就會介紹。

cues.en: And the second thing to note is that the more clusters we have, the smaller WCSS becomes.
cues.zh: 第二個要注意的是，群組越多，WCSS 就越小。

cues.en: You can even see it visually.
cues.zh: 光看圖就能看出來。

cues.en: So here, the distances are high, and especially when you square them, the WCSS will be quite large.
cues.zh: 這裡的距離很大，尤其平方之後，WCSS 會相當大。

cues.en: Then here, the distances are smaller, and so the WCSS drops.
cues.zh: 到了這裡，距離比較小，所以 WCSS 下降。

cues.en: And here, again, the distances become smaller and smaller.
cues.zh: 這裡也是一樣，距離越來越小。

cues.en: And so we can continue increasing the number of clusters until we get to the maximum number of clusters, which equals the number of data points that we have.
cues.zh: 因此，我們可以持續增加群組數量，直到最大值，也就是群組數等於資料點數量。

cues.en: And then WCSS will be actually exactly zero because each data point is its own centroid and the distance is zero.
cues.zh: 這時 WCSS 就會恰好等於零，因為每個資料點都是自己的質心，距離為零。

cues.en: And so, the chart that we can build from this looks like this.
cues.zh: 根據這些結果畫出的圖表就是這樣。

cues.en: This is the WCSS and, on the y-axis, and on the x-axis, we have the number of clusters.
cues.zh: Y 軸是 WCSS，X 軸是群組數量。

cues.en: As you can see, it drops off all the way down to zero, as we just discussed.
cues.zh: 如你所見，它會一路降到零，就像剛才討論的那樣。

cues.en: And the elbow method is very simple.
cues.zh: 手肘法非常簡單。

cues.en: It's actually a visual method when you look at this chart and you look for where is the kink in this chart, where is the elbow.
cues.zh: 它其實是視覺判斷法：看這張圖，找出曲線在哪裡彎折，也就是手肘的位置。

cues.en: There it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: And so that is your optimal number of clusters, basically when the WCSS stops dropping as rapidly.
cues.zh: 這就是最佳群組數量，基本上就是 WCSS 開始不再快速下降的位置。

cues.en: Of course, it's a judgment call, and sometimes, it can be unclear.
cues.zh: 當然，這需要判斷，有時候可能不明確。

cues.en: There might be two potential candidates or more candidates for the optimal number of clusters, but then, in those cases, it's something that you need to decide as the data scientist.
cues.zh: 最佳群組數量可能有兩個甚至更多候選值；遇到這種情況，身為資料科學家的你就必須做出決定。

cues.en: So there we go. That's how the elbow method works.
cues.zh: 這就是手肘法的運作方式。

cues.en: Hope you enjoyed this tutorial, and I look forward to seeing you next time.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡這堂課，期待下次再見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
